chapter.title: Start Here
subtitle: Spring, Year One.
Eight small things. The last one brings the first neighbour up the hill.

hover: Four pages. The last one is a map.
Forty marked blocks in the kitchen floor.
The holes are already in the walls.
A pot only cooks over lit fire.
Marnie is not carrying it home.

quests.title: Read Josie's Letter
quests.subtitle: The last page is a map.
description: Josie: "If you're reading this I'm dead and the valley is cold. Only one of those is your problem."
Right-click &aJosie's Letter&r in your bag and read all four pages. The last one maps the old Kettle farm.
Forty lamp posts stand along that road and not one is lit. New here? Read the &6Read Me First&r chapter.

tasks.title: Josie's Letter read — all four pages

rewards.title: Found on the Mantle
rewards.description: Next: follow the road to the Kettle farm gate, then put the waystone on the flat grey hearthstone in the kitchen floor.

quests.title: Put the Waystone on the Hearthstone
quests.subtitle: Name it Home.
description: Josie: "The hearthstone is the one thing in that house I never had to fix. Start from the part that held."
Follow the road to the old farm (&b-319 74 32&r): signposted gate, standing chimney, no door on the house. Put the &aHomestead Waystone&r on the flat grey hearthstone, type Home, click the tick.
Nothing is rebuilt and nothing is moved. It is your house from that moment. Scrolls and maps: &6Getting Around&r.

tasks.title: Homestead Waystone standing on the hearthstone, named Home

rewards.command: title @p subtitle {"text": "Start from the part that held.", "color": "gray", "italic": true}
execute at @p run playsound minecraft:ui.toast.challenge_complete master @p ~ ~ ~ 1 1

rewards.title: Home
rewards.description: Next: the door, two windows, the bed and the sconce are in your bag, and the holes are already in the walls.

quests.title: Hang the Door, Windows, Bed and Sconce
quests.subtitle: The holes are already in the walls.
description: Josie: "A house is a box until somebody shuts a door in it. Go and shut the door."
Put the &aOak Cottage Door&r in the doorway, one &aOak Window&r in each hole, the Red Bed on the wool mat and the Sconce on the hook. Any order is right.
The cottage becomes a home you can cook in, and the smoke off it is what brings Marnie up the hill.

tasks.title: Door, two windows, bed and sconce placed

rewards.title: Four Walls and a Door
rewards.description: Next: stand the Megatorch inside the cottage. Then the campfire, the kettle and one pot of soup.

quests.title: Place the Megatorch Inside the Cottage
quests.subtitle: One torch. It never goes out.
description: Josie: "The dark out here has opinions. The tall torch settles them, permanently."
Place the &aMegatorch&r on the cottage floor, inside the walls, where you can see it from the bed.
Nothing &chostile&r spawns near home again. The two spares are for the pens; lamps and lanterns live in &6Home and Town&r.

quests.title: Dig Out the Cellar Stairs
quests.subtitle: Forty marked blocks of gravel, going down.
description: Josie: "There's a door down there I'm not going to explain yet. Dig anyway; I know you."
Dig out the two-wide patch of &agravel&r in the kitchen floor — forty marked blocks — down to the stone stair she cut herself. The &airon shovel&r is in your bag.
At the bottom: a sealed iron door with no handle, four words in her chalk — Not yet. — J.K. — and a plinth for the &aCellar Waystone&r.

tasks.title: Standing in the cellar, at the bottom of the flight

rewards.command: title @p subtitle {"text": "No handle. Her chalk still on it.", "color": "gray", "italic": true}
execute at @p run playsound minecraft:block.bell.resonate master @p ~ ~ ~ 1 1

quests.title: Cook One Vegetable Soup
quests.subtitle: Kettle on the hook, pot on the fire.
description: Josie: "Kettle on the hook, soup in the pot. That is the entire ceremony."

Set the &acampfire&r down outside your door, hang the &aCopper Kettle&r over it, and cook one &aVegetable Soup&r in the Cooking Pot: cabbage, carrot, potato, beetroot and a bowl. Three planks make four bowls.
Bram's Surveyor's Stake is in the vegetable basket, in a rag with a chalk K on it. Ovens and kettles: &6Cooking and Brewing&r.

rewards.title: Put the Kettle On
rewards.description: Next: carry Bram's Surveyor's Stake up the road to the square and drive it into the socket he cut for it.

quests.title: Drive the Stake into Bram's Socket
quests.subtitle: Cut forty years ago. Never used.
description: Josie: "Bram surveyed that flat twice, cut the socket, and never drove the stake. Forty years of nearly. Drive it."
Walk up the road to the square (&b-302 69 -44&r). The chiselled socket is two blocks north of the town waystone, Bram's own sign beside it. Put the &aSurveyor's Stake&r in it.
Nothing is built. The square has stood here since long before you came — what changes is that the town is on the record, and the first two lamps come on.

tasks.title: Surveyor's Stake driven into the socket on the square

rewards.command: title @p subtitle {"text": "This is where the town will be.", "color": "gray", "italic": true}
execute at @p run playsound minecraft:block.bell.resonate master @p ~ ~ ~ 1 1

rewards.title: Lantern Road 2/40
rewards.description: Next: sleep one night in your own bed. Marnie has been watching that chimney for four years.

quests.title: Sleep One Night in Your Bed
quests.subtitle: Marnie sees the chimney.
description: Marnie: "Four years I've looked at that chimney, and last night there was smoke. I've brought bread and I am not carrying it home."
Sleep one night in the &aRed Bed&r in your cottage.
Marnie opens the inn she has kept with no guests in it, Bram opens the mill, and she leaves you her seed sack, 32 &aGreen Oak Planks&r and a flint and steel.

tasks.title: Slept one night in the cottage bed

rewards.title: Residents 1/15
rewards.description: Next: till the 3x9 patch behind the house, dry green planks in Marnie's oven, and go and see Bram at the mill.
